title: Standlar project list and permission-gated configurator routes

database.reason: Project rows live in Fair Stand DB; CRM lists via Stand API.

migration.reason: No CRM schema migration for Standlar list routes.

backend.reason: Project API is hosted by Fair Stand; CRM only mounts list and shell routes.

api.reason: CRM client calls Stand list/detail/DELETE, PATCH /{id}/customer, cost-items list and catalog bootstrap. No new CRM backend routes and no persisted cost calculation.

audit.reason: No new CRM audit stream for list page.

forms.reason: List actions column has delete confirm and Başka müşteriye ata confirm. Cost quantity is local calculation input and is not submitted.

backend_tests.reason: API auth tests live in fair-stand; CRM covers UI and nav tests.

notes: Replaces public /fair-stand shell entry with permission-gated Standlar list. Configurator stays standalone at /stand-projects/new and /:id. Assigning a project to another customer is the actions-column confirm dialog; it PATCHes customerId and does not run on drawing save. Maliyet Hesapla opens /stand-projects/:id/cost from the Standlar and customer project action columns. It reads the current project, runs the existing resolveProjectBom, and matches ITEM cost rows by item_key. MANUAL rows are selected on the page with a quantity and are not stored. A BOM-sourced row is labeled Sahne Elemanı; a manual row stays Manuel. The row source code stays BOM. The route requires projects.read and the existing cost_items.read permission. No new permission and no cost snapshot. Excel İndir downloads the current visible cost rows and totals as a local xlsx named from the project. The file is not stored.
